quest.title: Stolen, by the Rightful Owner
quest.description: The bard Taliesin seeks your help. As it turns out, the ring that he stole from the Weasel Thieves has been stolen once again by another bunch of Weasel Thieves...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Weasel Thief Training Manual
dialogues.text: "...About the feeding schedule for Weasel Thieves..."

dialogues.speaker: Weasel Thief Training Manual
dialogues.text: "...Amateur Weasel Thief: Feed after noon to keep their excessive energy in check... Recommended Time: <color=#00E1FFFF>12:00–23:59</color>"

dialogues.speaker: Weasel Thief Training Manual
dialogues.text: "...Hoarder Weasel Thief: Feed before noon to allow a more flexible training schedule... Recommended Time: <color=#00E1FFFF>2:00–11:59</color>"

dialogues.speaker: Weasel Thief Training Manual
dialogues.text: "...Golden Weasel Thief: The most cunning of all. Limit its feeding and interacting window within two hours... Recommended Time: <color=#00E1FFFF>0:00–1:59</color>"

dialogues.speaker: Weasel Thief Training Manual
dialogues.text: "All Weasel Thieves listed above can be summoned during their respective feeding hours. Stand on a large rock and summon them by whistling. Avoid whistling for fun, as it may lead to unnecessary trouble!"

dialogues.speaker: Weasel Thief Training Manual
dialogues.text: "...By Erge. Weasel Thief Trainer on Duty This Month: Clitopho... Scheduled Days: 31 (Late: 27)..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Don't the Treasure Hoarders ever take breaks?

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Ahem... My bad. As a poet, I have a propensity for dramatic language and novel tales.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Hehe, truth be told, I found the ring in a Weasel Thieves' nest... It was well-preserved and eye-pleasing, so I kept it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, so you're a thief too, you just stole from thieves!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Don't say that... I chanced upon it! That's right, it was chance! And though chance it be, the ring is quite precious to me all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any clue concerning the ring's whereabouts?

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Yeah... I've heard that Weasel Thieves are often spotted around here. They might've stolen my ring while I was sleeping.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so there really are people who take their rings off before going to bed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd never heard of such people before, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, Paimon doesn't have that habit! You need to think about where to put the ring once you take it off, or you'll be wasting good beauty sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do they even make rings tiny enough for you, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, of course they do! There's much you still don't know!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Enough. Please refrain from judging other people's way of living before proceeding to ramble on about your own! It's very rude!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, if you want to help out... Please keep an eye out for Weasel Thief nests.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: I've heard that there is a camp of suspicious Treasure Hoarders around here on the map... I've marked the location out for you.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: It's said that Weasel Thieves are often spotted around here. Those sneaky Treasure Hoarders probably have something to do with them... Anyway, please take a look there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph... A ring stolen from the Weasel Thieves, which was then stolen again by other Weasel Thieves. Paimon'd say it has gone back to its rightful owner!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, just stop it already!

talks.objective: Look for the ring that was stolen from Taliesin

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: You're back. Did you find it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take a look. Is this your ring?

talks.objective: Give the ring back to Taliesin

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Yes, it is! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: Please take these as your reward. It isn't much, but please don't feel offended. I'll compose verses to eulogize your deeds!

talks.objective: Give the ring back to Taliesin

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't believe this story.

talks.objective: Give the ring back to Taliesin

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: *sigh* This doesn't make sense. How weird.

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: It should be around here... But why can't I find it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: My ring... It's gone. It means a lot to me. I must find it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What does it look like?

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: It's made of brass and is inlaid with a beautiful red gem...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: I found it by a lava lake where the shadow dragon Durin fell in the legends. Or at least, this should explain why its luster resembles dark flames...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa...

dialogues.speaker: Taliesin
dialogues.text: It is said that the Lord of the Abyss will fix its malefic gaze upon the ring bearer and send an army of darkness to hunt them down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dragonspine doesn't have a lava lake.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hey there, has something happened recently?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Weasel Thieves...

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean the ones in The Chasm... I was assigned to take care of them, but I messed up, so there's really nothing much to say.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Eh... It's impossible for me to capture them again. They are, after all, masters of hide-and-seek. It's so hard to track them down.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: But I can help you a bit if these annoying creatures happen to have stolen things from people.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Weasel Thieves trained by Treasure Hoarders are fed at fixed hours in a day. There are three types of Weasel Thieves...

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: The Golden Weasel Thief is the most cunning one... Then, there's the more common Hoarder Weasel Thief. The dumbest of all is the Amateur Weasel Thief. Well, as for when they show up...

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: *sigh* There should be a training manual somewhere with the feeding timetable on it, as no one really bothered to remember the exact time. The manual should be in the camp frequented by Weasel Thieves.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Ah... I almost forgot this! Give a whistle if you want to summon them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give a whistle?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Yep, just any old whistle will do. It's not some complicated trick. The key is the timing.
